evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the model shows notable gains in context understanding, structured data processing, and long-context comprehension, positioning it for complex coding, instruction-following, and text generation.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned on synthetic data combining coding logits and CoT datasets; synthetic data can include hallucinations, and no factual grounding or evaluation is reported.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: The checkpoint is fine-tuned on a synthetic dataset, which may not capture the complexity and nuances of real-world coding and reasoning data.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card mentions synthetic data combining recent coding logits and CoT datasets but does not provide traceability of the data's origin or generation process.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not document how the synthetic data was collected, curated, or generated, making it harder to explain model behavior.

possible_risks.description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight coding-focused model with no reported safety evaluation or alignment for code output, so it may generate code that causes harm.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,540,133,904 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was fine-tuned on a synthetic dataset using recent coding logits and CoT datasets, with further optimization of chain-of-thought reasoning and logical problem-solving abilities.
training_context.training_data: The checkpoint was fine-tuned on a synthetic dataset that combines recent coding logits and chain-of-thought datasets to improve reasoning and logical problem-solving.
